mapper.select: SELECT f.id, f.content, f.contact, f.contact_name, f.type, f.status, f.reply, f.created_at, f.updated_at, r.rating FROM feedback f LEFT JOIN feedback_rating r ON f.id = r.feedback_id ORDER BY f.created_at DESC

SELECT f.id, f.content, f.contact, f.contact_name, f.type, f.status, f.reply, f.created_at, f.updated_at, r.rating FROM feedback f LEFT JOIN feedback_rating r ON f.id = r.feedback_id WHERE f.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO feedback (content, contact, contact_name, type, status, reply, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{content}, #{contact}, #{contactName}, #{type}, #{status}, #{reply}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE feedback SET content = #{content}, contact = #{contact}, contact_name = #{contactName}, type = #{type}, status = #{status}, reply = #{reply}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
